name: project_demonstration_benchmark
description: Small labeled project benchmark for local regression and configuration comparisons. It is not a production-scale relevance benchmark.

documents.content: Machine learning trains algorithms from data to make predictions or decisions.
Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn representations.
BM25 ranks documents using lexical term relevance while dense retrieval uses embeddings.

queries.query: How do BM25 and dense retrieval differ?
